description: This file contains Python code for generating C++ source code related to JSON-RPC API classes and enums, including functions for emitting enum registration code and class definitions based on JSON schema objects.

methods.name: EmitEnumRegs
methods.description: Generates C++ enum registration code for a given root schema and enum objects, writing to an emitter object.

methods.name: EmitObjects
methods.description: Generates C++ class and enum definitions based on JSON schema objects, handling nested classes, enums, and various constructors, writing to an emitter object.
